messages:
Ivy L: Hi everyone, excited to start! Two quick issues: 1) clicked the Okta invite and got 'account exists - service account collision' (never created one). 2) Tried to enroll a passkey but the browser errors during navigator.credentials.create. Also 1Password invite hasn't shown up. Who should I ping?

Dana (IT): Welcome Ivy! That 'service account collision' usually means a preprovisioned SCIM stub used your alias. Can you confirm the exact invite email? Also, are you on the corporate VPN or a split-tunnel where some Okta endpoints might be blocked?

Ivy L: Invite was to ivy.lopez@redwood.dev. I'm on home Wi-Fi, using corp VPN (split-tunnel). Browser is Chrome on macOS. Error in console: "SecurityError: The operation is insecure."

Dana (IT): Thanks. Two actions: 1) I'll look up any SCIM stubs and merge/remove the placeholder so we can reissue the invite. 2) split-tunnel VPN can block required Okta endpoints for WebAuthn; try disabling VPN for the flow or use your phone with Okta Verify for passkey. I'll open ticket IT-57299 and send a magic link if we need to bypass.

onboarding-bot: [automated] Ticket IT-57299 created  "SCIM stub collision for ivy.lopez@redwood.dev + passkey via split VPN". Assigned Dana (IT). ETA 2h.

Hector - People Ops: Ivy, I added you to onboarding-temp so you get calendar and docs while IT works this. 1Password seats had a short SCIM delay earlier; I raised PL-1219 to vendor. Do you need immediate repo access?

Ivy L: Docs + calendar is enough for now. I can try the no-VPN flow. If reissuing helps, please do.

Dana (IT): I removed the stale SCIM stub, reissued invite to ivy.lopez@redwood.dev, and DM'd you a one-time magic link (expires 12h) in case passkey still fails. Try the invite with VPN off or use phone Okta Verify.

Ivy L: Turned off VPN and retried in Chrome incognito  invite completed. Okta Verify mobile passkey enrollment worked and I can sign in now. Still no 1Password invite but I can access onboarding docs. Thanks!

Hector - People Ops: Vendor confirmed 1Password provisioning (PL-1219). Expect invite in ~15 mins. Welcome aboard Ivy! :tada:

Ivy L: 1Password invite arrived and I set up vaults. All good now. Appreciate the quick turnaround.

Dana (IT): Great. We'll file a short KB note about split-tunnel VPN causing WebAuthn errors for new hires. If you want to switch to hardware YubiKey later, open a ticket and we'll swap factors. Enjoy your first day!
